title: Rescission and avoidance
summary: Rescission or avoidance concerns undoing or declining enforcement of an agreement on an applicable ground, with attention to restoration and other legal consequences.
notes: The misrepresentation and mistake readings raise different bases for this remedy. Identify the defect, the party entitled to invoke it, and the effect of later conduct or an allocation of risk. Avoidance is a separate question from how damages for breach would be measured.
